decision_basis: ANG/RNase5-EGFR association and catalytic-independent EGFR phosphorylation and cancer-cell function support qualified-high relay/function evidence.
ANGPT1 alpha5beta1-dependent adhesion and Tie2-complex crosstalk with FAK/p85-Akt, motility, and survival outputs support qualified-high complex relay/function evidence.
ANGPT4 stimulation with Tie2/Akt/ERK phosphorylation and endothelial/lymphatic function supports qualified-high relay/function evidence.
Exact AVP/V2R Gs/cAMP-PKA and beta-arrestin/c-Src transactivation branches with secretion or ERK outputs support qualified-high relay/function evidence.
